correctness.rationale: The patch replaces the two hard-coded install.sh/test.sh checks with a nullglob-enabled loop over all five explicitly requested locations (*.sh, scripts/*.sh, scripts/checks/*.sh, scripts/setup/*.sh, scripts/lib/*.sh), runs bash -n on each match, and emits independent pass()/fail() lines—matching the parser-only per-file contract. One-point deduction because bundle evidence cannot confirm full-suite runtime behavior after expanded coverage, whether latent syntax errors elsewhere would have required fixes in the same diff, or negative-smoke acceptance.

quality.rationale: Implementation is minimal, readable, and scoped to the single required check file. nullglob is enabled before the loop and restored afterward with a brief rationale comment; the explicit glob set is documented inline per issue #281. Deductions for redirecting bash -n stderr to /dev/null (hides syntax-error detail on failure), no defensive [[ -f ]] guard for odd path edge cases, and no richer inline rationale for bats exclusion beyond implicit glob scoping.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly focused on scripts/checks/055-script-syntax.sh only (1/1 files changed) with no unrelated churn, satisfying objective scope at 15/15. Bundle contains no verification notes, bash test.sh output, narrow syntax-check output, negative-smoke demonstration or explanation, or documented no-change doc-sync decision required by acceptance criteria.

reliability.rationale: Objective evidence confirms test_wiring (6/6) and bash_n_check_script pass, and the diff integrates with existing pass/fail helpers sourced by test.sh. Bundle lacks full_test_sh execution evidence (skipped in bundle-only grading), no reported command output, and no negative-smoke test or explanation that a deliberate syntax error is caught and cleared.

uncertainty_notes: Bundle contains no bash test.sh run output, narrow syntax-check output, or negative-smoke demonstration/explanation required by acceptance criteria; reliability scored conservatively.
